correctness.rationale: Predator equation nullcline sets u=B/(1+alpha v) exactly. Clearing positive factors in prey equation yields quartic with strictly negative constant and quadratic/cubic/quartic coefficients, so Descartes counts at most two positive zeros by multiplicity. In z=alpha v and t=1/alpha, each z has a unique threshold t_*(z); maximum attained at positive z, and Descartes forces exactly one double equilibrium at threshold, two simple above, none below. Determinant -uv g_u F_alpha_prime yields lower saddle. The rational witness bracketing and trace bound proves upper sink and prey-only sink. This is local bistability, not a global basin theorem.
